name: Reverse String
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to reverse a given string.

Some examples:

- Turn `"stressed"` into `"desserts"`.
- Turn `"strops"` into `"sports"`.
- Turn `"racecar"` into `"racecar"`.
introduction:
# Introduction

Reversing strings (reading them from right to left, rather than from left to right) is a surprisingly common task in programming.

For example, in bioinformatics, reversing the sequence of DNA or RNA strings is often important for various analyses, such as finding complementary strands or identifying palindromic sequences that have biological significance.
example_solution:
(module
  (memory (export "mem") 1)
 
  (func (export "reverseString") (param $offset i32) (param $length i32) (result i32 i32)
    (local $temp i32)
    (local $low i32)
    (local $high i32)

    (local.set $low (local.get $offset))
    (local.set $high (i32.sub (i32.add (local.get $offset) (local.get $length)) (i32.const 1)))

    (if (i32.lt_u (local.get $low) (local.get $high)) (then
      (loop
        ;; Swap
        (local.set $temp (i32.load8_u (local.get $low)))
        (i32.store8 (local.get $low) (i32.load8_u (local.get $high)))
        (i32.store8 (local.get $high) (local.get $temp))

        (br_if 0 (i32.lt_u 
          (local.tee $low (i32.add (local.get $low) (i32.const 1)))
          (local.tee $high (i32.sub (local.get $high) (i32.const 1)))
        ))
    )))

    (return (local.get $offset) (local.get $length))
  )
)
